pages.text: A tablet is a laptop you carry as an item.$(br2)Hold it in your main hand and left-click to open its terminal. Everything else works like a laptop. The tablet keeps its binding, screen and history even while it lies in a chest.
Turn a laptop into a tablet. The crafted device gets a new terminal that is not bound yet.
Bind your tablet to a quiz program and take it with you. When the program asks a question, open the tablet anywhere and type your answer.
